source.title: 回测中的未来函数排查清单：十分钟自检

scope: qlch production B4_K3+MA20; E2 hold 2 days

hpdk_rank_oracle_positive_control.interpretation: weak response; K=10 while KSLOT=20, so ranking within the selected top-10 rarely binds portfolio capacity

hpdk_entry_day_low_price_positive_contro.interpretation: strong detector response to an impossible hindsight fill; this is a control, not a strategy result

qlch_realized_return_rank_positive_contr.interpretation: strong detector response to ranking on realized future returns; control only

limitations: A successful positive control proves sensitivity to the injected violation class only; it does not prove that every strategy or every small-magnitude timing error is clean.
This run did not replay forum performance claims from topics 911 or 918 and does not validate their return figures.
The audit reads local panels and was run to a scratch output path; the source strategy file hash is unchanged.
